verdict.rationale: Sill's privacy page says it ships no analytics, ads, tracking or third-party SDKs, and has no account or server. Its only outbound call, a daily GitHub update check, can be turned off in Settings › General, so there is nothing left to opt out of. missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification (e.g. a network-traffic audit) that no telemetry is sent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: No analytics, ads or tracking, and no code from third parties (SDKs) in either app.
There is no account and no server: your screen and what you type travel only between your own devices
Unless you turn off “Check for updates automatically” in Sill’s Settings › General, once a day it asks GitHub (api.github.com) whether a newer version of Sill has been released
